__NOTOC__{{NPC infobox | type = Grawl | image = [[file:Grawl caster.jpg|200px]] | affiliation = Vanguard foes | profession = mo | level = 10, 14, 18 | boss = y | campaign = Prophecies | map1 = [[File:Vanguard Bounty Utini Wupwup.jpg|200px]] | map1-text = Possible spawning locations in [[Green Hills County]] }} [[Utini Wupwup]] is a [[Grawl]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Green Hills County]] during [[Vanguard Bounty: Utini Wupwup]]. == Locations == *[[Ascalon (pre-Searing)]] **{{NPC location|Green Hills County}} (only during [[Vanguard Bounty: Utini Wupwup]]) == Skills == Level 10: 0 [[Divine Favor]], 5 [[Healing Prayers]], 6 [[Protection Prayers]], 10 [[Smiting Prayers]]
Level 18: 13 Smiting Prayers * {{skill icon|Bane Signet}} * {{skill icon|Banish}} * {{skill icon|Healing Breeze}} * {{skill icon|Orison of Healing}} * {{skill icon|Retribution}} * {{skill icon|Shielding Hands}} * {{skill icon|Symbol of Wrath}} ==Dialogue== :''"UTINI!"'' == Notes == * Utini has four possible spawn locations in Green Hills County. == Trivia == * ''"Utini!"'' is a [[w:Languages_in_Star_Wars#Jawaese_and_Jawa_trade_language|Jawa battle cry]] from the movie "Star Wars: A New Hope". Similarly, the phrase ''"wupwup"'' is heard from the Ewoks in "Star Wars: Return of the Jedi". * There are two other grawl bosses that share the Wupwup last name: [[Ipillo Wupwup|Ipillo]] and [[Kaia Wupwup|Kaia]].
